opinions: I BELIEVE GLOBAL UNITY IS CRUCIAL TO EFFECTIVELY COMBAT CLIMATE CHANGE.
I PRIORITIZE PEACEFUL RELATIONS OVER NATIONAL STRENGTH.
I THINK SOCIETY IS CONTINUALLY EVOLVING AND HAS BOTH POSITIVE AND NEGATIVE CHANGES COMPARED TO THE PAST.
I SUPPORT THE PRINCIPLE OF DISTRIBUTION BASED ON NEED AND CONTRIBUTION.
I BELIEVE WORKERS SHOULD HAVE A SAY IN THE MEANS OF PRODUCTION THEY UTILIZE.
I SUPPORT THE LEGALIZATION OF SAME-SEX MARRIAGE.
I THINK MAINTAINING CORE FAMILY VALUES IS IMPORTANT BUT SHOULD BE ADAPTABLE TO MODERN CONTEXTS.
I SEE THE STATE AS A NECESSARY ENTITY FOR PROTECTING LIBERTY, NOT A THREAT TO IT.
I BELIEVE CHILDREN SHOULD BE EXPOSED TO A VARIETY OF VALUES, INCLUDING RELIGIOUS AND TRADITIONAL ONES.
I THINK REGULATED MARKETS CAN OFFER MORE FREEDOM THAN COMPLETELY FREE MARKETS.
I BELIEVE HEALTHCARE SHOULD BE A RIGHT, NOT A PRIVILEGE BASED ON ABILITY TO PAY.
I DO NOT BELIEVE A HIERARCHICAL STATE IS THE BEST FORM OF GOVERNANCE.
I CONSIDER CLIMATE CHANGE ONE OF THE MOST PRESSING THREATS TO OUR WAY OF LIFE.
I SUPPORT GUN OWNERSHIP REGULATIONS TO ENSURE THEY ARE JUSTIFIED AND SAFE.
I BELIEVE GOVERNMENTS SHOULD BE ACCOUNTABLE BOTH NATIONALLY AND INTERNATIONALLY.
I THINK MIGRANTS SHOULD BE ENCOURAGED TO INTEGRATE WHILE MAINTAINING THEIR CULTURAL IDENTITIES.
I VALUE TRADITIONS BUT BELIEVE THEY SHOULD EVOLVE WITH SOCIETY.
I THINK GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION CAN BE NECESSARY TO STABILIZE THE ECONOMY.
I BELIEVE MILITARY ACTION SHOULD BE A LAST RESORT FOR NATIONAL PROTECTION.
I THINK PROSTITUTION LAWS SHOULD FOCUS ON SAFETY AND CONSENT RATHER THAN CRIMINALIZATION.
I BELIEVE ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE CRITICALLY EXAMINED BUT NOT NECESSARILY QUESTIONED.
I THINK TRADITIONS HAVE VALUE BUT SHOULD NOT BE PRESERVED AT ALL COSTS.
I CONSIDER MAINTAINING LAW AND ORDER ESSENTIAL FOR A FUNCTIONING SOCIETY.
I BELIEVE WARS SHOULD BE JUSTIFIED THROUGH INTERNATIONAL LAW AND CONSENSUS.
I SEE DEMOCRACY AS MORE THAN A PROCESS; IT’S A CULTURE OF PARTICIPATION AND VALUES.
I THINK SOME CIVIL LIBERTIES CAN BE JUSTIFIABLY SACRIFICED FOR SECURITY, BUT WITH CAUTION.
I BELIEVE THE GENERAL POPULACE CAN MAKE INFORMED DECISIONS WITH THE RIGHT INFORMATION.
I SUPPORT THE IDEA THAT ALL CULTURES HAVE INHERENT VALUE.
I THINK BASIC UTILITIES SHOULD BE ACCESSIBLE TO ALL, POSSIBLY THROUGH PUBLIC OWNERSHIP.
I DO NOT BELIEVE SEX OUTSIDE MARRIAGE IS INHERENTLY IMMORAL.
I AM OPTIMISTIC ABOUT THE BENEFITS OF AUTOMATION, SCIENCE, AND TECHNOLOGY FOR A BETTER WORLD.
I THINK A BALANCE BETWEEN REASON AND CULTURAL MAINTENANCE IS IMPORTANT.
I BELIEVE BOTH CORPORATE AND GOVERNMENTAL OPPRESSION ARE SIGNIFICANT CONCERNS.
I STRONGLY SUPPORT EQUAL TREATMENT FOR ALL PEOPLE, REGARDLESS OF DIFFERENCES.
I DO NOT THINK ALL MILITARY SPENDING IS A WASTE; SOME IS NECESSARY FOR DEFENSE.
I CONSIDER ENVIRONMENTAL REGULATIONS ESSENTIAL FOR SUSTAINABILITY.
I BELIEVE GOALS SHOULD BE PURSUED WITH CONSIDERATION FOR THE BROADER COMMUNITY, NOT JUST ONE GROUP.
I SUPPORT THE LEGALIZATION OR DECRIMINALIZATION OF DRUG USE WITH PROPER REGULATION.
I SUPPORT SINGLE-PAYER, UNIVERSAL HEALTHCARE AS A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT.
I AM SKEPTICAL ABOUT THE FEASIBILITY AND BENEFITS OF A UNITED WORLD GOVERNMENT.
I THINK TARIFFS SHOULD BE USED JUDICIOUSLY TO SUPPORT LOCAL PRODUCTION WITHOUT HARMING INTERNATIONAL RELATIONS.
I SUPPORT OPENING BORDERS TO IMMIGRATION WITH MANAGED INTEGRATION PROCESSES.
I BELIEVE LOYALTY TO ONE’S COUNTRY SHOULD NOT OVERRIDE UNIVERSAL HUMAN RIGHTS AND ETHICAL CONSIDERATIONS.
I SUPPORT INCREASING TAXES ON THE RICH TO REDUCE INEQUALITY AND SUPPORT THE POOR.
I AM CAUTIOUSLY OPTIMISTIC ABOUT GENETIC MODIFICATION, WITH STRICT ETHICAL GUIDELINES.
I BELIEVE QUALITY EDUCATION IS A FUNDAMENTAL RIGHT FOR ALL PEOPLE.
I DO NOT BELIEVE STRONGER LEADERSHIP INHERENTLY LEADS TO BETTER OUTCOMES; IT DEPENDS ON THE LEADER’S VALUES AND ACTIONS.
I THINK ALL INSTITUTIONS, INCLUDING CHURCHES, SHOULD BE SUBJECT TO FAIR TAXATION.
I BELIEVE LONG-TERM THINKING IS CRUCIAL FOR SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT.
I SUPPORT REGIONAL UNIONS LIKE THE EUROPEAN UNION FOR FOSTERING COOPERATION AND PEACE.
I DO NOT CONSIDER INTERNATIONAL AID A WASTE OF MONEY; IT IS CRUCIAL FOR GLOBAL DEVELOPMENT.
I THINK GOVERNMENT SURVEILLANCE SHOULD BE LIMITED AND SUBJECT TO OVERSIGHT TO PROTECT PRIVACY.
I BELIEVE IN MAINTAINING NATIONAL SOVEREIGNTY WHILE ENGAGING IN INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION.
I DO NOT THINK THE GOVERNMENT SHOULD FOLLOW MAJORITY OPINION IF IT IS CLEARLY WRONG OR UNJUST.
I BELIEVE ENSURING WELFARE FOR ALL CITIZENS IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN MAINTAINING A BALANCED BUDGET.
I DO NOT SUPPORT ABOLISHING SOCIAL PROGRAMS IN FAVOR OF PRIVATE CHARITY ALONE.
I BELIEVE PERSONAL RELIGIOUS VALUES SHOULD BE A MATTER OF INDIVIDUAL CHOICE, NOT WIDESPREAD IMPOSITION.
I DO NOT SUPPORT PROHIBITING ABORTION IN MOST OR ALL CASES; WOMEN SHOULD HAVE AUTONOMY OVER THEIR BODIES.
I SUPPORT INTERNATIONAL RESEARCH COLLABORATION FOR GLOBAL CHALLENGES.
I BELIEVE GOVERNMENTS SHOULD CONSIDER THE WELL-BEING OF BOTH THEIR CITIZENS AND FOREIGNERS.
I THINK CHASING PROGRESS WITHOUT CONSIDERATION FOR CONSEQUENCES IS DANGEROUS.
I DO NOT SUPPORT SPREADING ONE NATION’S VALUES OVER OTHERS; CULTURAL DIVERSITY SHOULD BE RESPECTED.
I BELIEVE GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT CONSUMERS.
I BELIEVE PEACEFUL PROTEST IS MORE EFFECTIVE AND ETHICAL THAN VIOLENCE, EVEN AGAINST AUTHORITARIAN GOVERNMENTS.
I THINK PUBLICLY-FUNDED RESEARCH CAN BE MORE BENEFICIAL TO THE PUBLIC THAN MARKET-DRIVEN RESEARCH.
I SUPPORT THE LEGALIZATION OF PHYSICIAN-ASSISTED SUICIDE UNDER STRICT CONDITIONS.
I THINK INHERITANCE SHOULD BE REGULATED TO PREVENT EXCESSIVE CONCENTRATION OF WEALTH.
I BELIEVE IN RECOGNIZING A NATION’S STRENGTHS WHILE ALSO ADDRESSING ITS FLAWS AND WORKING TOWARDS IMPROVEMENT.
I DO NOT SUPPORT THE INTERTWINING OF RELIGION AND GOVERNMENT; THEY SHOULD REMAIN SEPARATE.
I DO NOT SUPPORT ABOLISHING THE UNITED NATIONS; IT PLAYS A VITAL ROLE IN INTERNATIONAL COOPERATION AND CONFLICT RESOLUTION.
